# <span id="aanchor67"></span> Time Zone Editor

The Time Zone Editor allows you to enter time zone names and GMT offset data that you can then access in areas throughout FLOWCAL, such as the Meter Editor.

<div class="procedure">

To access the Time Zone Editor and modify time zone options:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**.
2.  Select **Time Zone** in the **Geographic** group.
3.  Select a time zone from the list and click the **Edit** button.
4.  Update the time zone data at the bottom of the screen as needed.
5.  Click the **Save** button.

To add a new time zone:

1.  Click the **New** button.
2.  Enter the time zone data at the bottom of the screen. The GMT Offset value (required) must be a value between 12 and -12.
3.  Click the **Save** button. The time zone will now be available within FLOWCAL.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 605;height: 294;" />

Once created, time zones cannot be deleted.

</div>

When the Time Zone Shift option is enabled for a meter or location, all dates and times will be adjusted by the offset amount defined for the selected time zone during data imports. (See: [Date &amp; Time Adjustments During Import](../../Meters/Meter%20Editor/Date%20and%20Time%20Adjustments%20During%20Import.md) and [Import Options](../../Meters/Meter%20Editor/Imports%20Tab.md))

When the Time Zone Shift option is disabled for a meter or location, the offset is informational only. Time Zone Shift options are disabled by default.
